pairs: Audite verbum quod locutus est Dominus super vos,
Listen to the word which the Lord has spoken about you,
filii Israël,
sons of Israel,
super omnem cognationem quam eduxi de terra Ægypti,
concerning the whole family that I led out of the land of Egypt,
dicens:
saying:
Tantummodo vos cognovi ex omnibus cognationibus terræ;
I have known only you in such a way, out of all the families of the earth.
idcirco visitabo super vos omnes iniquitates vestras.
For this reason, I will visit upon you all your iniquities.
Numquid ambulabunt duo pariter,
Will two walk together,
nisi convenerit eis?
unless they have agreed to do so?
numquid rugiet leo in saltu,
Will a lion roar in the forest,
nisi habuerit prædam?
unless he has prey?
numquid dabit catulus leonis vocem de cubili suo,
Will the lion’s young cry out from his den,
nisi aliquid apprehenderit?
unless he has taken something?
numquid cadet avis in laqueum terræ absque aucupe?
Will a bird fall into a snare on the ground, if there is no bird-catcher?
numquid auferetur laqueus de terra antequam quid ceperit?
Will a snare be taken away from the ground, before it has caught something?
si clanget tuba in civitate,
Will the trumpet sound in a city,
et populus non expavescet?
and the people not become frightened?
si erit malum in civitate,
Will there be disaster in a city,
quod Dominus non fecerit?
which the Lord has not done?
Quia non facit Dominus Deus verbum,
For the Lord God does not fulfill his word,
nisi revelaverit secretum suum ad servos suos prophetas.
unless he has revealed his secret to his servants the prophets.
Leo rugiet,
The lion will roar,
quis non timebit?
who will not fear?
Dominus Deus locutus est,
The Lord God has spoken,
quis non prophetabit?
who will not prophesy?
Auditum facite in ædibus Azoti,
Let it be heard in the buildings of Ashdod
et in ædibus terræ Ægypti,
and in the buildings of the land of Egypt,
et dicite:
and say:
Congregamini super montes Samariæ,
Gather together across the mountains of Samaria,
et videte insanias multas in medio ejus,
and see the many absurdities in its midst,
et calumniam patientes in penetralibus ejus.
and those who are suffering false accusations in its inner most places.
Et nescierunt facere rectum,
And they do not know how to make it right,
dicit Dominus,
says the Lord,
thesaurizantes iniquitatem et rapinas in ædibus suis.
storing up iniquity and plunder in their buildings.
Propterea hæc dicit Dominus Deus:
Because of these things,
Tribulabitur
thus says the Lord God:
et circuietur terra:
The land will be encircled and squeezed together.
et detrahetur ex te fortitudo tua,
And your strength will be drawn away from you,
et diripientur ædes tuæ.
and your buildings will be torn apart.
Hæc dicit Dominus:
Thus says the Lord:
Quomodo si eruat pastor de ore leonis duo crura,
Just as if a shepherd had rescued two legs from the mouth of a lion,
aut extremum auriculæ,
or the tip of an ear,
sic eruentur filii Israël,
so also will the sons of Israel be rescued,
qui habitant in Samaria in plaga lectuli,
who dwell in the sick bed of Samaria,
et in Damasci grabato.
and in the cot of Damascus.
Audite,
Listen
et contestamini in domo Jacob,
and give testimony in the house of Jacob,
dicit Dominus Deus exercituum;
says the Lord God of hosts:
quia in die cum visitare cœpero prævaricationes Israël,
that in the day, when I will begin to visit the betrayals of Israel,
super eum visitabo, et super altaria Bethel;
I will visit upon him and upon the altars of Bethel.
et amputabuntur cornua altaris, et cadent in terram.
And the horns of the altars will be cut off and will fall to the ground.
Et percutiam domum hiemalem cum domo æstiva,
And I will strike the winter house with the summer house;
et peribunt domus eburneæ,
and the houses of ivory will perish,
et dissipabuntur ædes multæ,
and many buildings will be torn apart,
dicit Dominus.
says the Lord.
